title: Political Alignment in Large Language Models: A Multidimensional Audit of Psychometric Identity and Behavioral Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Administering political psychometric tests (Political Compass, SapplyValues, 8 Values) to measure intrinsic ideological positioning, and evaluating behavioral alignment through a downstream news bias classification task using articles from Ground News to detect systematic perceptual shifts and asymmetric extremism detection.
